analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: Global Privacy Notice - Provides a comprehensive overview of privacy practices at DigiCert and its affiliated brands.

analysis.headline: Shares with Third-Party Sub-processors
analysis.quote: DigiCert works with third-party sub-processors, including vendors and service providers, that process personal data on our behalf.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric/Facial Data
analysis.quote: Remote Identity Verification (RIV), also known as Identity Proofing, is a method to verify and authenticate the identity of a person through government identification, biometrics, facial recognition, or other means of identity validation.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Internationally
analysis.quote: When DigiCert transfers personal data across country borders, we do so in compliance with applicable data protection laws and regulations.

analysis.headline: Seeks Your Biometric Consent
analysis.quote: As part of this process, we will obtain your consent prior to collecting your identity information and provide you an opportunity to withdraw your consent.

analysis.headline: You Have Privacy Rights
analysis.quote: You have certain rights with respect to your personal data. This includes, among others, rights to access your personal data, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion, restrict processing, object to processing, and data portability.
